title: Prove regrouping rewrites over theory atoms by their structure in Lean
summary: The Lean reconstructor now proves large regrouping rewrites over theory atoms by an explicit propositional proof, with atoms as opaque leaves and dropped tautologies proved by excluded middle, instead of a tactic that ran out of heartbeats. Six QF_UF quasigroup benchmarks that Lean rejected now verify, with the trust boundary unchanged.
